text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week, who had produced splendid results
in both the Japanese Derby and the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her booming success was gradually
becoming the talk of the entire Academy...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Alright...!!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! Spe-senpai, did you get faster again!?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I always had the impression that Spe-senpai's generation
was packed with absolute powerhouses, but...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Spe-senpai really feels like she's standing head and shoulders
above the rest lately...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...However.
On the other hand—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh...
I! AM! NUMBER OOOONE!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Guh...! S-Such speed...!
To be left behind by this big of a gap...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Is this the strength of someone who races overseas...?
There's no way... I could ever catch up...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A red hood and fluttering dark bay coat—
some call him the "Phantom Bird"!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The world's strongest, El Condor Pasa!!
Has once again deee-scended
upon the grounds of Tracen Academyyy!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, aiming for the Japan Cup,
let's keep hyping ourselves up more and more, yes!
¡Vamos!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa, who has taken on overseas races and possesses overwhelming ability.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —Phew.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... N-No way...
I know it was only a 1,600m mock race, but
how can she look so calm and collected...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*...
And to top it off... you even set a course record...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
...A "monster."
That title truly suits her best...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well... fufu, quite an exaggerated title
seems to have spread around, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the Junior Class,
Grass Wonder had made her name known with formidable ability.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing before Special Week, who aims to be 'the best in Japan',
there were still high walls blocking the way...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Good work, Trainer!
Time to cool down and—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Oops, Spe-chan!
Do you have a moment to talk, YES?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
El-chan...?
What did you want to talk about?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh... Well, you see!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: DECLARATION! OF! WAAAR!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I know about them, Spe-chan, yes I do!
The Japan Derby and the Tenno Sho (Spring)...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Success! Success! Tremendous success!
Even El must acknowledge that, yes!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Howeeeever!!
—The title of the strongest is not something I will surrender.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: The strongest...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The strongest! That means number one!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Both Spe-chan and I strive to be the best in Japan,
so our ultimate destination is the same, yes!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why! I can't give this up! I won't back down!
I absolutely refuse to lose!!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —Let's settle this at the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: El-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
Let's settle this at the Japan Cup...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Special Week was set to challenge the "Monstrous Bird," El Condor Pasa...!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan... I see.
At last, you and El...
